task.objective: Maintain freight routes, feed towns and contest physical passage through shared station actions while preserving bridges and carriers.
task.natural_termination: No early natural terminal; a fixed 1024-tick settlement season truncates.
task.interaction: Building changes others routes; switches commit choices; destination passage controls eligibility; power depletes; braking and edge reservations cause queues; cargo affects origin and recipient.
task.observation_access: Surveyed corridor geometry is public. Only selected nearest site/link/train/agent rows reveal operational state. Home identity grants no remote treasury or signal view. Explicit decaying local bulletins convey route information. Off-view events are debug-only.

human_control.camera_recommendation: Focus selected actor or crew, show role/tool and nearby object labels; full-world state is a labelled debug view.
